attractions._note: Each place: km from our gate, about (short description), best (time of day), where (area). 'maps' is optional: the search words for Google Maps.

do.name: Swamymalai trek
do.about: The highest peak in Yelagiri, at about 1,320 m. Roughly 6 km there and back, around 3 hours at an easy pace. Managed by the Forest Department with a ticket, so ask us to help you book.

do.name: Selfie Panda & Chocolate Factory
do.about: Themed photo spots and a shop selling homemade chocolates. A quick, fun stop with children, and a good place to pick up something sweet to take home.

do.name: Aqua Fountain & Birds Park
do.best: Morning, when the birds are most active
do.about: A small park with bird enclosures and fountains. Easy walking, so it suits young children and older family members.

do.name: Yelagiri Birds Park
do.best: Morning, when the birds are most active
do.about: Colourful birds in large enclosures that you can walk past and watch up close. A gentle outing for families.

do.name: Fundera Park
do.about: A bird park with more than 300 exotic birds in walk-in aviaries. You can see them up close and, at set times, feed them. One of the most visited places in Yelagiri.

do.name: Cloud Forest Entertainment Park
do.best: Morning to early afternoon; allow 2 to 3 hours
do.about: Butterfly and flower gardens, a petting area, a fish spa, a large play zone, a short bamboo-forest walk and a suspension bridge with hill views, all on one ticket.

do.name: Boat House, Punganoor Lake
do.best: Early morning, or after 4 PM when the sun is softer
do.about: Yelagiri's main lake, with rowing and pedal boats and a fountain in the middle. Weekends get busy, and some counters take cash only, so carry some.

do.name: Lake Zone Adventure Park
do.about: Outdoor adventure activities and games for children and adults. Combine it with boating at Punganoor Lake, which is nearby.

do.name: Thrill Valley Adventure Park
do.about: An adventure park with outdoor rides and activities for groups of friends and families with older children.

do.name: Wild Waves Theme Park
do.about: A theme park with rides and games, popular with families on weekends.

do.name: Mountain View Adventure Park
do.about: Zipline, giant swing, archery, target shooting and net cricket, sold as packages of 1 to 2.5 hours. Good for groups and teenagers.

visit.name: Sivan Temple
visit.about: A quiet local temple to Lord Shiva, close to the resort. A peaceful start or end to the day.

visit.name: Murugan (Velavan) Temple
visit.best: Morning or evening; closed for a few hours around midday
visit.about: A hilltop temple to Lord Murugan, reached by a flight of steps, with a large statue at the entrance and wide views over the hills.

visit.name: Nilavoor View Point
visit.about: A cliff-edge viewpoint with sweeping views over the valley and the plains below. Free to visit and much quieter than the lake.

visit.name: Perumal Temple
visit.about: A local temple to Lord Vishnu, visited by families from the villages around Yelagiri.

visit.name: Nature Park
visit.where: Next to the Boat House, Punganoor Lake
visit.best: From 5 PM, staying for the 7 PM fountain show
visit.about: Landscaped gardens, a greenhouse and walking paths beside the lake. The musical fountain show runs every evening at 7 PM and has its own ticket.

visit.name: AR Thanga Kottai
visit.about: A popular stop on the Yelagiri sightseeing route.

visit.name: Jalagamparai Waterfalls
visit.where: Below the Yelagiri hills, about 40 km by road
visit.best: Morning; fullest from October to February
visit.about: A waterfall in the forest below Yelagiri, best after the monsoon. Plan it as a half-day trip, carry water and wear shoes with a good grip.
